name: MP Stretch
description: Tubedigga MP Stretch. Cyclic, Length, Pitch, Phase, Delay, and Rate process the track and can be automated from the MPC sequencer. Delay at 0 leaves the stretch unchanged. Rate at 44100 Hz is full band. On MPC Sample: Knob FX with Cyclic/Length/Delay and SHIFT Phase/Pitch/Rate.
author: Tubedigga
